answer: The thread graph is validated at intake and the delta frontier is published, as a result the ancestry of every answer is public, and cipher anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 40 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. Each impostor pays 20 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
